COMMISSION AUTHORITY

        The Commission exercises jurisdiction over public utilities in Louisiana pursuant to Article

IV, Section 2l(B) of the Louisiana Constitution, which provides the following:


                The commission shall regulate all common carriers and public

                utilities and have such other regulatory authority as provided by

                law. It shall adopt and enforce reasonable rules, regulations,

                and procedures necessary for the discharge of its duties, and shall

                have other powers and perform other duties as provided by law.
